statement: A dirt patch in the forest a few minutes' walk from the shelter field holds about four long sticks, 19 handfuls of leaves, splintered wood and 5 twigs; a long stick was taken and wielded
The player crafted a quarterstaff from memory inside the shelter (fabrication reached 2) and now wields it
A cooking pot (aluminum pot) recipe needs a tool with hammering 3, a heat source such as a fire or lighter-fed cooker, and 1 aluminum chunk or 5 scrap aluminum; it cannot be crafted in the dark
The shelter door-side lockers hold an emergency jacket, whistle, FEMA pamphlet, flashlight, clean water and a sealed plastic bottle with 2 clean water; the sealed bottle was taken
The player picked up a lighter with 72 of 100 butane charges near the shelter entrance
Crafting clean water from 1 water needs a charcoal water purifier (12 charges), large charcoal water purifier or water purifier
A mixed zombie group (fat, firefighter, zapper, swimmer, decayed) is 46-60 tiles to the northeast and east of the shelter field; a panicked person was bitten by zombies near the shelter door
A rotten human corpse with scattered clothes (bra, dress, gloves, fedora) lies about 48 tiles west of the shelter field, with other loose items nearby
A one-hour melee (beginner) practice craft with any weapon raises melee to 1 and teaches the Brawling style; the player did this
The shelter window curtains and rod can be torn down, giving sheets that disassemble into 11 cotton sheets each
Crafting a bindle from cotton sheets and a stick and disassembling it yields 1 stick and 1 cotton sheet back; the player repeated this several times to pass time
NPC Racheal Burris in the shelter is neutral, ignores the player and wields a 4-round semi-auto hunting shotgun
The charcoal water purifier recipe requires a gallon jug, cotton patches and charcoal, so sustainable clean water is unresolved
Eustis town lies north-northeast of the field the shelter sits in; the player plans to scout it for a cooking container or gallon jug
The game was saved and quit; Stirling City (1) appears in the load menu next to Diamond Bluff (1)

note: two fat zombies still reported 60 tiles NW; decided to ignore and continue west
returned east across field and road to the shelter after collecting a long stick
crafted the quarterstaff from the long stick using the pocket knife
plan step of getting a stick and making a quarterstaff completed

clean water recipe check; basement toilet water is not clean and needs purification
